bug_semantics: is_vm_area_hugepages() in mm/vmalloc.c returns `find_vm_area(addr)->page_order > 0` without checking find_vm_area()'s return value. find_vm_area() returns NULL when the given address is not a valid vmalloc area (lookup of the address in the vmap area tree misses), so the unchecked dereference of ->page_order on NULL crashes the kernel — NULL pointer dereference (CWE-476) reachable from callers such as alloc_large_system_hash() when CONFIG_HAVE_ARCH_HUGE_VMALLOC is enabled.
flaw_origin: Commit 121e6f3258fe393e22c36f61a319be8a4f2c05ae ("mm/vmalloc: hugepage vmalloc mappings", 2021-04-29, author Nicholas Piggin <npiggin@gmail.com>, committer Linus Torvalds) introduced is_vm_area_hugepages() with the unguarded `return find_vm_area(addr)->page_order > 0;` inside the CONFIG_HAVE_ARCH_HUGE_VMALLOC branch and wired its first caller `huge = is_vm_area_hugepages(table);` into alloc_large_system_hash(). The parent tree (5d87510de15f31d1b26cffced7bc4d504539a2c7) has zero is_vm_area_hugepages occurrences in mm/vmalloc.c (grep count 0). The fix commit's own Fixes: tag cites 121e6f3258fe ("mm/vmalloc: hugepage vmalloc mappings"), confirming the BIC.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author Nicholas Piggin <npiggin@gmail.com> and committer Linus Torvalds (2021-04-29), message and lkml links entirely human; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot/AI identity anywhere on the object.
evidence: Advisory (CVE-2026-74327 / GHSA-fcv5-2rgw-v385, kernel CVN entry): 'vmalloc: fix NULL pointer dereference in is_vm_area_hugepages()'; find_vm_area() can return NULL if the given address is not a valid vmalloc area; check the return value before dereferencing to avoid a kernel crash; seven stable backports listed at git.kernel.org/stable/c/ (55a44f52, a1bca6b6, af71c2b8, b86f98e5, bbd664b7, c55dd3b4, c741485f).

Fix commit c55dd3b46c1208d6d2ea737a8aefef4aa4c70cb8 (2026-05-29, Hui Zhu <zhuhui@kylinos.cn>, Signed-off-by Andrew Morton, Link: https://lore.kernel.org/20260529014130.671291-1-hui.zhu@linux.dev): carries `Fixes: 121e6f3258fe (\"mm/vmalloc: hugepage vmalloc mappings\")`. Diff is exactly the null-check: `-\treturn find_vm_area(addr)->page_order > 0;` becomes `+\tstruct vm_struct *area = find_vm_area(addr); +\treturn area && area->page_order > 0;`.

BIC creation check: `git show 121e6f3258fe | grep is_vm_area_hugepages` shows the helper's introduction at line 89 of the diff (`static inline bool is_vm_area_hugepages(const void *addr)`) with `return find_vm_area(addr)->page_order > 0;` in the CONFIG_HAVE_ARCH_HUGE_VMALLOC branch, plus first caller `huge = is_vm_area_hugepages(table);` in alloc_large_system_hash(); parent 5d87510de15f mm/vmalloc.c has 0 is_vm_area_hugepages occurrences (introducer_parent_absent=true for the function).

Version boundary: BIC first ships in tag v5.13 (v5.13.1 also; tag --contains head); the unguarded deref persisted through 5.13-6.x mainline until the 2026-05 fix; stable backport 55a44f5259e6's message reads '[ Upstream commit c55dd3b46c1208... ]' confirming the mainline/original relationship.
